verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's marketplace lets users filter offers by GPU type. The homepage advertises GB200 availability, a Blackwell-class current-generation datacenter GPU. Cheaper older options appear in live probe results (RTX 4090) and in community data (A100 PCIe at $0.79/hr, RTX 3090 at $0.38/hr). However, H100, H200 and B200 are never named, and current-gen availability rests on a single marketing line. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of H100/H200/B200 offers, a documented GPU catalog or inventory list, and independent confirmation of current-gen availability and pricing.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options

citations.quote: NVIDIA GB200s are now available. Rent GB200s

returning real RTX 4090 offers with CUDA versions, vCPUs, RAM, disk, and per-hour prices
